name: The Beaumont
positioning: The Beaumont Mayfair, an Art Deco modernist hotel with a boutique attitude in central London, home to Sir Antony Gormley's sculpture suite ROOM
best_for: Art and design lovers who want to sleep inside a Gormley sculpture
Families or groups wanting connected rooms and suites in Mayfair

facts.text: The Beaumont Mayfair is an Art Deco modernist hotel with a boutique attitude in central London.
Each room has a unique selection of original prints, books and paintings.
Premier Rooms use bronze mirrors, mohair velvets and silks that reflect an Art Deco aesthetic.
Each Mayfair Suite has its own library of specially selected reading material.
The Roosevelt Suite is available as a one-bedroom or a five-bedroom suite.
The Junior Suite Wing groups a Deluxe Junior Suite, a Premier Junior Suite and a Superior Grand Room in a separate corridor, for families or larger groups.
Superior Grand Rooms can interconnect, suiting guests travelling with children.
Signature suites include a fully complimentary mini bar, including alcohol.
Guests have use of the hotel's chauffeur-driven car.
Some Superior Grand rooms are designed to be fully accessible for guests with reduced mobility.
The hotel's restaurant is Rosi, and Le Magritte is the hotel bar, serving classic cocktails.
The Gatsby Room serves afternoon tea and a wide range of Champagnes.

highlights.text: The bedroom of the ROOM suite sits inside a giant semi-abstract sculpture by Sir Antony Gormley on the hotel's entrance front on Brown Hart Gardens.

Inside ROOM, a dark oak-clad bedroom is reached up nine white marble steps and separated by a black velvet curtain from a white marble bathroom; outside, its stainless steel form is a giant crouching figure based on the artist's body.
Mayfair Suites are the largest one-bedroom suites, and most overlook Brown Hart Gardens or the rooftops of Mayfair.
The Spa & Hammam offers treatments seven days a week.
The Premier Junior Suite with Terrace has a separate dressing area and a private outdoor terrace.

considerations.text: Classic Rooms look over a quiet side street or the inner courtyard rather than Brown Hart Gardens.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the Mayfair positioning.
WhataHotel notes an intimate boutique size with limited room inventory.
